data.standardized_narrative: At 1 January 2022 the Syndicate had gross claims outstanding of GBP 221.885m. Analysis of the gross claims development triangle indicates an aggregate gross prior-year adverse movement of approximately GBP 9.4m (c.4.2% of opening gross reserves), driven by adverse development on older years (notably 2013). The report however discloses a net prior year favourable development of GBP 3.3m (net of reinsurance), reflecting significant movements in the reinsurers' share (including funds-withheld arrangements). The Syndicate also notes claims inflation and deterioration in casualty business and material transactions during the year (RITC of Syndicate 5678 and large funds-withheld quota share arrangements) which distort comparatives and reserve development.

data.data_quality_notes: Gross prior year development was not stated explicitly in a 'movement in prior year provision' note in gross terms; the report only states net prior year development (+GBP 3.3m). A gross prior year movement was therefore calculated from the gross claims development triangle, yielding a gross adverse movement of approx GBP 9.397m. However this triangle and reserve movements are likely distorted by material transactions in 2022 (RITC of Syndicate 5678, Hiscox ADC and the Gibson Re funds-withheld quota share), and the presence of large reinsurer movements (reinsurers' share increased materially). Because the report explicitly gives only net PYD and because of RITC/funds-withheld distortions, the gross PYD should be treated as approximate.
